intro: Captain Grayson's ghost watches Westfall's rocky coast, where his ship broke on the rocks. He blames Old Murk-Eye for driving the lighthouse keeper's family from their post, then killing them in a later attack. Now he calls on travelers to hunt the murloc chieftain and bring justice to the shore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me. The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off. They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again. The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.
Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet? He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.
Return to me when the foul beast is dead.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead. Well done, friend. By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved. The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
